messages:
maria (Support): Customer reports invoice payment failing with their company card. Happened 3x at checkout, bank response = 'do_not_honor'. Customer says vendor is 'PrintSupplyCo' and their card program blocks certain MCCs. Can payments team confirm what we return and any immediate workarounds?

jonathan (Payments Eng): Can you paste the gateway decline object + last4/BIN? Also: is this a virtual card from a program (Ramp/Divvy) with per-merchant controls?

maria (Support): Pasted below (redacted):
```
{"gateway": "stripe", "status": "failed", "error": "card_declined", "decline_code": "do_not_honor", "mcc": "5734", "acquirer_code": "05"}
```
Card: BIN 411111, last4 4242, yes it's a virtual company card (issued via vendor program). Customer says admin enabled 'restrict by merchant category' for office supplies category and PrintSupplyCo is being blocked.

jonathan (Payments Eng): OK — this looks like an issuer-enforced block (do_not_honor on a company-managed virtual card). From our side the gateway returned a generic decline; we can't override issuer MCC policies. Workarounds: 
- Ask customer to whitelist vendor/MCC with their card admin;
- Use an alternate funding source (company bank transfer/ACH, wire);
- For one-off payments, ask finance to add a card exception or use a personal card + request reimbursement.

kevin (Acct Exec): Customer says they can't change company policy quickly (procurement committee). They have a PO number requirement too, so ACH/wire is preferred. Can we mark the invoice as 'pending manual pay' so they can send wire and we reconcile?

maria (Support): I can set invoice to 'awaiting payment' flag in console. Need invoice id and PO number from customer. Also customer asked if we can retry the card after merchant whitelist — yes, but they'll need to trigger retry from their side or we can reattempt if they provide explicit consent.

jonathan (Payments Eng): For our records, capture the full payment attempt payload so Finance can reconcile once wire arrives. Repro steps for internal follow-up:
1) Console -> Billing -> Invoices -> choose invoice -> Pay -> select company card -> Submit => reproduces decline.
2) API repro (internal only):
```
POST /v1/payments
{ "invoice_id": "INV-12345", "payment_method": "card_abc", "idempotency_key": "repro-1767" }
// response: 402 + {
  "error": "card_declined",
  "decline_code": "do_not_honor",
  "mcc": "5734"
}
```
Add logs: gateway_request_id=ch_1JH... , acquirer_code=05.

jonathan (Payments Eng): Notes for runbook: if MCC block suspected, do NOT instruct customer to re-enter card repeatedly (risk of multiple failed auths). Instead: get BIN+last4, capture gateway request id, advise customer to contact card admin to whitelist merchant or temporarily lift MCC controls. If they can't, provide wire/ACH instructions + mark invoice awaiting payment. After customer confirms whitelist, we can reattempt.

maria (Support): Got PO and wire intent from customer. PO: PO-78901. I'll set invoice to awaiting payment and send wire instructions. cc @billing-bot to create finance ticket for reconciliation. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Finance ticket FIN-2026 created for invoice INV-12345, assigned to payments-recon. Please include gateway_request_id and customer wire confirmation.

kevin (Acct Exec): I'll coordinate procurement and follow up on the whitelist timeline. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria (Support): Closing loop here — will reopen thread if retry needed after whitelist.
